title: Co-Scientist and mechanisms of metabolic steatohepatitis (MASH)
summary: Filippo Menolascina (Edinburgh) used Co-Scientist to search the literature for combinations of MASH therapies. The tool proposed the NLRP3 inflammasome as a link between inflammation and metabolism, and the post says the hypothesis was later tested experimentally. No numbers are given; the drug combinations were suggested for testing, not demonstrated.
organization: Google DeepMind; and University of Edinburgh

evidence.tested: The article says the NLRP3 hypothesis was later experimentally verified but does not describe the experiments, who carried them out, or their results.
evidence.unknown: Not reported (the article does not state limitations or whether the work is published).
evidence.ai_role: Co-Scientist searched the literature, proposed drug combinations for MASH therapy and proposed the NLRP3 inflammasome as the link between inflammation and metabolism.
